disposition: not_promoted; exact legislative vehicle unresolved and legal-category counterexample not established
claim_and_request_reference: research/targeted-expansion/energy-leads.json, energy-selection-mibrag-reserve-scope; no repeated original quotation here.

scope_investigation.positive: Original register ties the paper to a general market-return proposal and EnWG, with no printed-matter or draft field. Full one-page paper cites the coalition agreement rather than a draft.
scope_investigation.closest_official_draft_checked: BMWE StromVKG consultation of April27,2026; cover and operative purpose concern a2031capacity market. Whole-text searches found no network-reserve or market-return provision. This is insufficient to establish that no other proposal exists.
scope_investigation.remaining_gate: An actual federal bill/regulatory draft and precise market-return mechanism must be identified before a version-matched legal-description issue could be alleged.

primary_results: Current EnWG13d expressly defines network reserve for system security, especially congestion management, and allows some installations to participate in capacity-reserve procurement under its separate conditions.
Current NetzResV7 expressly confines network-reserve use to outside electricity markets on TSO system-security instructions. A proposal would require changing or supplementing this framework.

Commission SA.42955paragraph48 expressly classified the2016German network reserve as a capacity mechanism in strategic-reserve form with a regional function. This affirmatively prevents assuming the author confused categories solely because the German labels differ.

Regulation2019/943Article2(22), including its2024amendment, excludes ancillary-services/congestion-management measures from its capacity-mechanism definition. The actual purpose/design of a price-stabilisation market-return mechanism would determine whether this exclusion applies; its name alone does not.
benign_explanations: The author may correctly view a paid reserve used to cap price peaks as a strategic capacity mechanism subject to Article22, even if the ordinary network reserve performs congestion management.
The categorical conclusion can be a legal assessment of proposed policy design rather than a false description of an already identified draft.
Domestic outside-market conditions and state-aid commitments may independently constrain market return even if the cited Article22 category is disputed.
limits: No conclusion that reserve return is legal, unlawful, economically harmful, beneficial, prohibited forever or authorised by the2016decision. The2016approval ended in2020 and cannot establish the current state-aid position. Missing exact draft is a scope gate, not a proved author error. No intent inference.
next_action: Ask independent agent to challenge the conservative non-promotion; then move to another concrete unread claim rather than prolong a legal-label dispute.
